nodes.description: Owner address storage variable inherited from Ownable; set to msg.sender in constructors and mutated by transferOwnership/renounceOwnership.
Total fragment supply, initialized to INITIAL_FRAGMENTS_SUPPLY in the constructor and returned by totalSupply().
Conversion rate between gon balances and user-visible fragment balances; computed in constructor as TOTAL_GONS.div(_totalSupply).
Mapping of address to internal gon balance, credited/debited by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to allowed fragment allowance, written by approve/increaseAllowance/decreaseAllowance and consumed by transferFrom.
Constant supply configuration: INITIAL_FRAGMENTS_SUPPLY, TOTAL_GONS, MAX_UINT256 and MAX_SUPPLY used for supply and conversion-rate setup.
Constant token metadata: name 'Kawaii Inu Shiba', symbol 'KAWAIIS' and decimals 18.
Ownable constructor that assigns msg.sender to _owner and emits OwnershipTransferred.
Token constructor: sets _owner, _totalSupply, credits TOTAL_GONS to _owner and computes _gonsPerFragment.
View function returning the current _owner address.
onlyOwner function that emits OwnershipTransferred and sets _owner to address(0).
onlyOwner function that validates newOwner is non-zero and writes it into _owner.
Access-control modifier requiring _owner == msg.sender before executing the guarded function body.
Modifier that rejects transfers whose recipient is the token contract itself.
View function returning _totalSupply.
View function returning _gonBalances[who] divided by _gonsPerFragment.
Transfers fragments by converting value to gons, debiting msg.sender and crediting the recipient.
View function returning _allowedFragments[owner_][spender].
Spends allowance of msg.sender and moves gon balances from 'from' to 'to'.
Sets _allowedFragments[msg.sender][spender] to value and emits Approval.
Adds addedValue to the caller's allowance for spender using SafeMath.add.
Reduces the caller's allowance for spender, clamping to zero when subtractedValue >= oldValue.
SafeMath library implementing guarded add, sub, mul, div and mod used for all token arithmetic.
Caller-controlled address read in constructors, onlyOwner, transfer, transferFrom, approve, increaseAllowance and decreaseAllowance.
Arithmetic in transfer: value.mul(_gonsPerFragment) plus subtraction/addition of gonValue on _gonBalances.
Arithmetic in transferFrom: allowance sub(value) and gon balance sub/add of value.mul(_gonsPerFragment).
Arithmetic in increaseAllowance/decreaseAllowance: addition and conditional subtraction on _allowedFragments.
Unchecked constant arithmetic TOTAL_GONS = MAX_UINT256 - (MAX_UINT256 % INITIAL_FRAGMENTS_SUPPLY) evaluated at compile time.
Recipient address parameter of transfer.
Fragment amount parameter of transfer, multiplied by _gonsPerFragment.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom.
Fragment amount parameter of transferFrom, spent from allowance and balances.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Allowance amount parameter of approve.
Spender address parameter of increaseAllowance.
Amount added to the allowance in increaseAllowance.
Spender address parameter of decreaseAllowance.
Amount subtracted from the allowance in decreaseAllowance.
Address parameter of balanceOf used to index _gonBalances.
New owner address parameter of transferOwnership; must be non-zero.
Owner address parameter of allowance().
Spender address parameter of allowance().
Recipient address parameter checked by the validRecipient modifier.
Local gonValue in transfer = value.mul(_gonsPerFragment).
Local gonValue in transferFrom = value.mul(_gonsPerFragment).
Local oldValue in decreaseAllowance holding the current allowance before reduction.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned into _owner by both constructors.
Ownable constructor writes msg.sender into _owner.
KawaiiInuShiba constructor overrides _owner with msg.sender.
Constructor initializes _totalSupply with INITIAL_FRAGMENTS_SUPPLY.
INITIAL_FRAGMENTS_SUPPLY constant feeds _totalSupply initialization.
Constructor credits _gonBalances[_owner] with TOTAL_GONS.
Constructor computes _gonsPerFragment = TOTAL_GONS.div(_totalSupply).
TOTAL_GONS constant is the dividend of the _gonsPerFragment computation.
_totalSupply is the divisor when deriving _gonsPerFragment.
TOTAL_GONS is produced by unchecked constant arithmetic MAX_UINT256 - (MAX_UINT256 % INITIAL_FRAGMENTS_SUPPLY).
